test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Of the four words listed below, three are consistent in some manner and one is inconsistent. Select the inconsistent one.

Black pepper, cardamom, onion, cloves
solution:
Black pepper, cardamom, and cloves are spices, while onion is a vegetable used in cooking but not categorized as a spice.

Thus, out of all the options 'Onion' is the inconsistent one.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
